name: Happy Path — Business Current Account Opening
description: Full happy path sequence for JRN-004. A limited company director applies via web portal, Companies House lookup confirms active company with 2 directors and 2 PSC UBOs (both >25%), all 3 required individuals (the applicant + 1 other director + 1 non-director UBO) complete identity verification, automated CDD screening returns CLEAR on all individuals and the company, automated decision approves, business account is provisioned with dual-authorisation configuration, and the business portal is activated. Total elapsed time: 3–4 business days (typical — gated by director/UBO verification completion).

steps.description: Director submits company details: entity_type = limited_company, company_number = 12345678, account_type = business_current, applicant name/email/phone, role = director.

data.applicant: { first_name, last_name, email, phone, role: director }

steps.description: SVC-017 calls SVC-005 to create BusinessCustomer (prospect) and BusinessApplicationRecord. Entity type and deduplication checks pass.
BusinessCustomer (prospect) and BusinessApplicationRecord created. SVC-005 publishes BusinessApplicationStarted.

data.payload: { application_id, business_customer_id, company_number, entity_type, channel, started_at }

steps.description: SVC-005 returns application_id, application_ref, status: in_progress.
SVC-017 renders confirmation screen with application reference BCA-2025-00421. 'Verifying company details...' loading state.

SVC-005 calls Companies House API to retrieve company profile, officer list, and PSC list. Response: company status = active, legal_name = Example Tech Solutions Ltd, 2 directors (Sarah Thornton, James Chen), 2 PSCs (Sarah Thornton 50%, Priya Kapoor 30%).

Companies House data reconciled with applicant-provided data. DirectorRecord entities created for Sarah Thornton and James Chen. UBO staging created for Sarah Thornton (50%) and Priya Kapoor (30%). CompaniesHouseVerified published.

data.payload: { application_id, business_customer_id, company_number, legal_name, company_status: active, sic_codes: [62012], director_count: 2, ubo_count_from_psc: 2 }

steps.description: SVC-017 renders the company verification confirmation screen: verified legal name, CH number, registered address, incorporation date. Applicant confirms and proceeds.

steps.action: Confirm UBO list and provide contact details
steps.description: Applicant (Sarah Thornton) confirms the 2 UBOs from PSC register. Confirms James Chen is a director but not a UBO (no PSC entry). Provides Priya Kapoor's email for identity verification invitation. Sarah Thornton is both a director and UBO — her verification is done directly in-app.
UltimateBeneficialOwner entities created for Sarah Thornton (50%, shares) and Priya Kapoor (30%, shares). Two UBOIdentified events published.

data.payload: { ubo_id, business_customer_id, ubo_first_name, ubo_last_name, ownership_percentage, control_type: shares, verification_invitation_sent }

steps.note: Two UBOIdentified events published — one per UBO

steps.description: SVC-050 receives UBOIdentified events. Creates identity verification sessions for all 3 required individuals (Sarah Thornton — in-app; James Chen — email invitation; Priya Kapoor — email invitation). SVC-053 dispatches invitation emails to James Chen and Priya Kapoor.

steps.action: Sarah Thornton completes identity verification (in-app, Day 1)
steps.description: Sarah Thornton completes Onfido document capture (passport) and biometric liveness check directly in the application session. Biometric match score: 0.94. Address verification: confirmed.
steps.note: Applicant completes their own verification immediately. Other individuals complete async.

steps.description: SVC-050 persists IdentityVerification for Sarah Thornton (outcome: pass). Publishes DirectorVerified with individual_type = ubo (she is primarily a UBO; she is also a director — a DirectorVerified event for her director record is also published).

data.payload: { verification_id, business_customer_id, individual_type: ubo, ubo_id, outcome: pass, verified_name, verified_dob, verified_nationality: [GB] }

steps.description: James Chen completes identity verification via email invitation link (passport, biometric liveness: 0.91, address confirmed). DirectorVerified published with individual_type = director.

data.payload: { verification_id, business_customer_id, individual_type: director, director_id, outcome: pass, verified_name, verified_dob, verified_nationality: [GB] }

steps.description: Priya Kapoor completes identity verification via email invitation (passport, biometric liveness: 0.93, address confirmed). DirectorVerified published with individual_type = ubo.

data.payload: { verification_id, business_customer_id, individual_type: ubo, ubo_id, outcome: pass, verified_name, verified_dob, verified_nationality: [GB, IN] }

steps.description: SVC-014 receives all DirectorVerified events. All verifications now complete. BPH-005 begins. SVC-014 initiates parallel sanctions screening: company name, Sarah Thornton, James Chen, Priya Kapoor — 4 parallel calls to SVC-051.

calls: POST /screen { entity: 'Example Tech Solutions Ltd', type: company }
POST /screen { first_name: Sarah, last_name: Thornton, dob, nationality: [GB] }
POST /screen { first_name: James, last_name: Chen, dob, nationality: [GB] }
POST /screen { first_name: Priya, last_name: Kapoor, dob, nationality: [GB, IN] }

steps.latency_note: Hard limit: 3,000ms per call. All 4 calls run in parallel.

steps.description: All 4 screening calls return status = CLEAR within 3,000ms hard limit. Lists checked: OFSI, OFAC, UN, EU.

data.company: { status: CLEAR, lists_checked: [OFSI, OFAC, UN, EU], processing_time_ms: 248 }

steps.action: PEP + adverse media screening + risk scoring
steps.description: SVC-014 runs PEP screening (ComplyAdvantage) for all 3 individuals: all CLEAR. Adverse media screening on company name: CLEAR. Sector risk assessment: SIC 62012 (IT consultancy) = low risk. Jurisdictional risk: GB incorporation = low. Risk score: 18/100 → risk_category = standard. EDD not triggered.
steps.note: Internal SVC-014 processing — no external API call shown

steps.description: BusinessKycAssessment created (assessment_id, risk_category: standard, edd_required: false, next_review_date: +3 years). BusinessKYCCleared published.

data.payload: { assessment_id, business_customer_id, risk_category: standard, edd_required: false, next_review_date: 2028-06-18, cleared_at }

steps.description: SVC-005 receives BusinessKYCCleared. Decision engine evaluates: CH verified (active), all verifications passed, risk_category = standard, no sanctions hits, no EDD → APPROVED.
SVC-005 publishes BusinessApplicationDecisionMade with outcome = approved.
SVC-053 dispatches approval notification: 'Your business account application has been approved. We are now setting up your account.'

SVC-005 provisions BusinessAccount: allocates account_number = 62345678 from commercial range, sort_code = 60-83-21, computes IBAN/BIC. Writes dual-authorisation config: payment_approval_threshold = £5,000, 2 dual_authoriser roles (Sarah Thornton + James Chen). Updates BusinessCustomer.status → active.
Two events published: BusinessAccountOpened (account details) and BusinessAccountProvisioned (configuration, status = active).

events: BusinessAccountOpened: { business_account_id, business_customer_id, account_number, sort_code, iban, bic, opened_date, fscs_eligible: false }

BusinessAccountProvisioned: { business_account_id, business_customer_id, status: active, payment_approval_threshold: 5000, authorised_users_count: 2, payment_rails_enabled: [bacs, fps, chaps], provisioned_at }

steps.description: SVC-017 receives BusinessAccountProvisioned. Renders: 'Your account is ready. Sort code: 60-83-21. Account number: 62345678. IBAN: GB29BANK60832162345678.' Business portal setup prompt displayed.
Sarah Thornton creates username + password for business portal. Proceeds to biometric SCA setup (FIDO2/WebAuthn).
SVC-017 calls SVC-100 to create business portal credentials for Sarah Thornton (primary user). FIDO2/WebAuthn device registered. Biometric assertion stays on device.
Sarah Thornton authenticates with Face ID. SVC-017 calls SVC-100 to verify FIDO2 assertion. SCA confirmed.
Business portal activated. SVC-017 publishes BusinessDigitalChannelActivated.

data.payload: { business_customer_id, business_account_id, primary_user_id, sca_enrolled: true, activated_at }

steps.description: SVC-053 dispatches welcome communications: account details, sort code, IBAN, RM contact details, account opening confirmation PDF, terms and conditions. In-app: onboarding checklist (set up payees, invite James Chen as second authoriser to portal).

Journey complete. Business portal displays: account details, payment approval workflow (dual-authorisation > £5,000), payment rails (BACS/FPS/CHAPS), and onboarding checklist. Total journey: Day 1 (application + CH verification + Sarah's verification) + Day 2 (James + Priya verification + CDD + provisioning) = ~2 business days for this simple structure.
